description: This file implements a Bootstrap 2.0.4 Typeahead (autocomplete) plugin, defining the Typeahead class with methods for showing, hiding, rendering suggestions, and handling user interactions.

classes.name: Typeahead
classes.description: A class providing autocomplete functionality for input elements, managing suggestion list display, user interaction, and matching logic.

methods.name: select
methods.description: Selects the active suggestion, updates the input value, and hides the suggestion menu.

methods.name: updater
methods.description: Returns the selected item; can be overridden for custom update logic.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays the suggestion menu positioned below the input element.

methods.name: lookup
methods.description: Performs the search/match operation based on current input value and updates the suggestion list.

methods.name: matcher
methods.description: Default matching function to check if an item contains the query string.

methods.name: sorter
methods.description: Sorts matched items, prioritizing those starting with the query.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders suggestion items into the menu.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Moves the active selection to the next suggestion.

methods.name: prev
methods.description: Moves the active selection to the previous suggestion.

methods.name: listen
methods.description: Sets up event listeners for user interactions.

methods.name: keyup
methods.description: Handles keyup events for navigation and selection.

methods.name: keypress
methods.description: Handles keypress events for navigation and selection.

methods.name: blur
methods.description: Handles input blur event to hide suggestions after a delay.

methods.name: click
methods.description: Handles click events on suggestions to select them.

methods.name: mouseenter
methods.description: Handles mouse entering a suggestion item to set it as active.
